title: TikTok Creator Rewards
one_liner: TikTok pays for qualifying views on videos over 1 minute.
followers: 10,000 followers and 100,000 views in the last 30 days; 18+; personal account; selected countries.
pay: Reported $0.40-$1.00 per 1,000 qualifying views (3rd party, not official).
steps: Grow to 10,000 followers with short videos.
catch: High bar, only some countries, and per-view pay is small; most small creators earn more from direct streams first.

match.first_step: Test one 60-90 second video a week to learn longer formats now.
